design_decisions.capability_boundary: SourceArtifactStore protocol in kernel/source_store.py; unchanged LocalSourceStore behind it; sibling S3SourceStore in kernel/source_object_store.py. Wrapping S3PayloadStore was rejected: payload ownership/GC semantics differ (suffix keys, no payload registry, no GC surface). Kernel records and migrations untouched.
design_decisions.s3_client: PR83B1 SigV4 machinery reused (s3_request_headers gained optional precomputed content_sha256; S3StoreConfig; path-style; httpx only). Source namespace prefix kernel-sources is disjoint from kernel-payloads in a shareable bucket.
design_decisions.staging_discipline: Single-open two-pass staging: pass 1 streamed hash + pre/post fstat identity evidence; pass 2 streamed conditional PUT (If-None-Match: *) from the same fd signed with pass 1's SHA-256 (server verifies body end to end), re-hashed during upload; post-identity check; streamed read-back verification. Truncation/append/in-place mutation/between-pass mutation are IncoherentSourceError - never staged.
design_decisions.dedup_and_convergence: Dedup confirmed by full read-back hash (never presence); 412 conditional-create losers verify the winner's bytes; wrong bytes at a claimed content identity fail closed and are never overwritten; ambiguous PUT outcomes converge by re-observation with verified dedup.
design_decisions.availability_model: resolve() gates on HEAD presence + Content-Length (the local profile's stat analogue); acceptance and consumption are always content-verified (stage read-back, verify_artifact, materialize-to hash-while-write). Same-size tampering is caught by content hash, not length.
design_decisions.materialization_bridge: consumable_path_for(): local profile consumes the owned artifact path (zero behavior change); industrial profile consumes VerifiedSourceMaterializer working copies under MARKER_SOURCE_CACHE_ROOT - every hit re-verified by full hash, corruption forces rebuild from durable truth, deletion of cache files cannot affect the shared object.
design_decisions.profile_selection: AcquiredSourceRevision carries store_profile; resolve() refuses cross-profile blocks before kernel lookup; pre-PR83B3 blocks without the field are local-by-construction. MARKER_SOURCE_STORE_PROFILE + MARKER_SOURCE_S3_* + MARKER_SOURCE_CACHE_ROOT; missing industrial configuration raises (no silent local fallback).
design_decisions.fail_closure: legacy_submit_fallback is local-profile-only: industrial submissions propagate acquisition failures, reject missing source files, refuse path-trust authorization without a committed revision, and restart adoption logs per-row refusals instead of adopting unowned-path work.
design_decisions.ownership_separation: kernel-sources prefix disjoint from kernel-payloads; payload listing/deletion cannot see or remove source objects; source acquisition commits exactly the five source record classes - no payload rows exist that could authorize payload GC against source bytes.
